from_speaker: your most engaged customers are also your most-expensive
the more-intensive the work, the more expensive the outputs become
our_interpretation: Engagement means actual use of the service. Expense means the provider's total serving cost per customer, rather than the customer's subscription payment or an equivalent API bill.
The ordinary reading is a general relationship between heavier usage and higher serving costs, not an exceptionless ranking of individual customers.
Use February 2026, the latest complete monthly usage period before publication. The post supplies no measurement period.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable customer-level measurements show that the heaviest users generally incur the highest total serving costs, with more computationally intensive work increasing those costs.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable measurements show that heavier users generally do not cost more to serve, or that the claimed relationship reverses across representative services.
